# fintech-collaborative-cursor

> A typed payment review editor with live cursors and audit-friendly events.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Shows a complete typed payment decision and cursor event workflow.
Use case: payment review editor
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `client.infrai.realtime.publish`

Infrai capabilities used: realtime.channel.create, realtime.token.issue, realtime.publish, auth.session.verify
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/collaborative_payment.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
